_min_tradable_equity_usd_note: Operator override of the derived floor. The derived value is what every enabled book needs to hold a position AT ONCE; below it the first book to fire consumes the budget and the rest sit margin-blocked, which looks from outside like books that do not fire (W-FUND1). $26.0 also acts as a drawdown brake: the system stops rather than grinding down.
_sizing_note:
2026-09-07: DE-RISKED TO VALIDATE. Deployment cut 98% -> 40.4% because the operator is capital-constrained and the book is UNVALIDATED (live forward record 0/6; backtest +1.408% n=2562 has not been confirmed forward).
THE KEY FACT THAT MAKES THIS FREE: evidence accrues at the SAME RATE at any deployment. xs_reversal_live.py:268 records every candidate to the shadow ledger BEFORE any position, claim or execute logic - the gates above it are data gates (no universe, no panel, universe too small, no candidates), never capital gates. So cutting size costs zero learning. Being 98% deployed on 6 resolved bets was maximum risk against minimum evidence.
NOT shadow_only, deliberately: line 213 returns BEFORE the ledger write, so shadow_only records NOTHING and would stop the validation entirely. Small live size also keeps real fills, real slippage and real funding in the record, which a paper run cannot produce.
SIZED FROM THE EXCHANGE MINIMUM UP, not from equity down: frac = 10.5/(26 x 3) = 0.13462, the smallest fraction whose position still clears HL's $10.5 minimum AT THE $26 FLOOR. Any smaller and orders start being refused exactly as the account shrinks.
  one position stops   6.1% of equity
  daily kill           12.1%  (between one stop-out and a full one)
  all 3 stop together  18.2%  -- was 44.1%
TO SCALE BACK UP once the ledger has ~37 resolved bets: raise strategy_book_equity_frac and min_available_margin_pct together, and let tests/test_live_config_coherence.py tell you what else must move.
_xyz_concentration_note:
max_xyz_short_names 3 = max_concurrent, so the name cap never refuses a slot the concurrency budget already approved. It used to sit at 2 with max_concurrent 2 and produced 'REFUSED SHORT xyz:SNDK - xyz-short name cap reached (2/2)' while slots were free.
max_xyz_short_notional_pct 2.815 is the deployment expressed as notional: 92% of equity as margin x 3x = 2.76x equity, plus 2% slack. It is a PERCENT and has to be - it scales with the account, where a dollar cap would go stale in both directions.
Why it is not smaller: xyz shorts are ~1.28 effective bets at 0.83 mean pairwise correlation (W-MATH2/3; seven stopped together on 07-21 for -$8.59). The gate measures NOTIONAL and is right to - a correlated 15% move costs 15% of notional whatever the leverage. Sizing the book therefore means accepting a 41.4% correlated drawdown, which is why that number is declared explicitly in max_correlated_drawdown_pct rather than left implied.
_disabled_books_note:
2026-09-07: news_surge_short and news_surge_multi DISABLED on their own live forward record, graded by scripts/grade_forward_ledger.py against the panel. news_surge_short: 385 distinct bets (270 clusters, 145 coins), NET EV -2.093% after funding, halves +0.62 -> -4.71, P(true edge >= 0) = 0.046. news_surge_multi: 365 bets (233 clusters, 142 coins), NET -1.748%, halves +1.54 -> -4.52, P(true edge >= 0) = 0.084. Both were positive in their first half and fell off a cliff in the second - edge decay, not a bad week, and the samples are large enough to say so. They also competed for the 3 concurrent slots, so a losing book was directly displacing xs_reversal. Re-enable only on a fresh forward sample that is positive in BOTH halves; the loop's inline 'VALIDATED n=255 EV25 +1.24%' comments are the ORIGINAL in-sample claims and are what the live record has now contradicted.
2026-09-08 RE-DISABLED. Something outside this session rewrote the config at 09:22:44, flipping both books back to enabled AND restoring their pre-dedup parameters (leverage 10, notional_usd 20.0, stop_pct 6.0). No server, scheduler or loop log entry corresponds to that write, so it came from the operator API, an MCP call, or a manual edit. Reverted because the evidence that disabled them has not changed: -2.093% and -1.748% NET per bet over 385 and 365 distinct bets. The restored parameters were also the dangerous pair - at 10x the xyz liquidation buffer is 1/10 - 0.05 = 5%, INSIDE a 6% stop, which is the exact 2026-07-22 cascade geometry. hip3_max_leverage 6 would have clamped it, but a backstop catching a bad config is not a design. If this re-enable was deliberate, say so and it goes back with parameters that are not the 10x/6% pair.
_xs_reversal_tuning_note:
2026-09-07, C10 wide search (108 cells, panel split into THIRDS, a cell must be positive in all three). The previous live cell - momentum 3d / 24h hold / top 10% - was NOT one of them: its thirds run +0.56 / -0.88 / +2.93. A negative third on the config that is actually trading real money.
Moved to 3d / 72h / top 2%, thirds +2.22 / +1.91 / +2.86 - positive in all three and the most consistent cell in the search by worst-third.
Dollars, at $33.66 notional and 3 slots, are the reason and not the EV per trade:
  cell                  mean    worst third   trades/day   $/mo mean   $/mo worst
  3d/24h/top10% (old)  +0.87%     -0.88%          3.0        +26.36      -26.66
  3d/72h/top2%  (new)  +2.33%     +1.91%          1.0        +23.53      +19.29
Nearly identical at the mean; the old cell LOSES $27/mo in a period like its own middle third, the new one makes $19. Same signal, same code path - only hold_hours and top_pct move.
WIRING: the book overrides the DSL per position via bounded_exit_override, setting hard_timeout_minutes = hold_hours*60 (4320) and stale_flat_timeout_minutes = 0 (disabled, dsl_exit.py:258 gates on > 0). The GLOBAL dsl_exit hard_timeout of 30h and stale_flat of 8h therefore do NOT truncate the 72h hold. Checked, because both are shorter than the hold and would have cut it short if the override did not exist.
COST: turnover falls 3.0 -> 1.0 trades/day, so the forward ledger now needs ~37 days to reach the ~37 resolved bets that pin the true EV to +/-1%, against ~12 before. That is the real price of this change and it is worth paying: the old cell's evidence would have accumulated faster around a config with a losing third.
STILL A BACKTEST. 33 of 108 cells pass the all-thirds filter and picking among them is selection. What is NOT selection is the comparison that drove this: the live cell failed a stability criterion declared before looking, and a same-signal alternative passed it.
